protocol.constructor_program: one top-level selected op over two learned macro subexpressions, bounded depth two

interpretation.positive: Two independently trained meta-supervised, source-neutral constructors learned reusable causal expression motifs from 12 public meta task sets and each composed new previously unseen two-level graph structures, passing eight natural CHECK vetoes across eight synthetic cases and 64/64 complete new unseen eight-event heldout positive trajectories, with zero matched hard false positives.
interpretation.critical_limit: The sourcefree task originator constructed exactly two heldout topologies using the same two primitive subprograms that recur in meta training. The candidate is supplied a bounded DSL for selecting top-level operations and combining two motifs, so this demonstrates transfer of seen motifs to unseen trees, NOT invention of entirely new primitives, unbounded graph synthesis or authentic unfamiliar-source discovery.
interpretation.strong_peer: An independently authored, equally meta-trained strong construction peer got exactly the same 12 task sets, 24 new FIT cases and primitive/constructor search budget and achieved exactly the same 64/64 with zero hard false positives. No accuracy advantage was demonstrated. Peer has slightly lower or essentially equivalent measured whole-process CPU costs in these samples.
interpretation.secondary_controls: Frozen quadratic and gated recurrent comparator did not receive the 12 extra meta-supervision tasks and thus are NOT equally trained for a scientific superiority claim. Their negatives do not establish that meta-construction is better than strong equally trained peers.
interpretation.ablation: Removing the learned motif library prevents generating any candidate because the constructor is defined to require those motifs. This confirms program dependence on the library but is not a causally equivalent competence ablation versus an alternate fully trained representation.
interpretation.resource: Five independent whole GitHub-hosted Linux process measurements per arm/family/seed include startup, public meta training, FIT/CHECK and heldout; no equal native primitive FLOPs or complete science resource nonregression certificate. Note different training privilege for non-meta controls.
interpretation.not_scored: Naturally unfit recurrent models have null admitted positive/negative results. Numeric aggregate zero must not be represented as successful hard-negative testing or zero errors.
interpretation.next_science: F124-DC: preregister task-independent learnable type/graph rewrite mechanisms to construct previously unobserved primitives or larger compositional graphs. Hold out operator families by structural type, include equally meta-trained full-budget grammar-unaware controls. Do not use first-use original science until new sourcefree competence and native resources qualify.
